events.query: Spotify Web API scopes list sensitive restricted

events.fact: Spotify OAuth apps are created via the Spotify Developer Dashboard (developer.spotify.com/dashboard) by signing in, clicking "Create an App", entering App Name and App Description, and accepting the Developer Terms of Service [S2].

As of Feb 2026, Development Mode has strict restrictions: requires a Spotify Premium account for the app owner, is limited to one Development Mode Client ID per developer, caps authorized test users at 5, and requires allowlisting each user by email in the dashboard [S10, S17].

Extended Quota Mode is required for apps serving more than 5 users or going public. As of May 15, 2025, applications are accepted ONLY from established business entities operating an active, launched service with at least 250,000 MAUs, available in key Spotify markets, via a Google Form link [S10, S21].
Spotify review process for Extended Quota Mode / approval can take up to six weeks once submitted in the dashboard after form approval [S10].

Spotify's Developer Terms (effective May 15, 2025) explicitly prohibit using the Spotify Platform or any Spotify Content to train a machine learning or AI model or otherwise ingesting Spotify Content into a model [S12].
Spotify authorization endpoints include standard authorization code flow, authorization code with PKCE (S256), and client credentials [P4, S1].
